calculation.description: For each tradable asset, remove its rolling 60-day beta exposure to the cross-sectional median market return, then fade the idiosyncratic daily shock. The reversal is amplified during robustly unusual five-day US10Y/CN10Y spread changes. US10Y and CN10Y are tradable benchmark series and are used as the macro conditioning inputs; all 15 assets remain eligible outputs.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.060465, 592 observations), 2023-2024 (+0.057006, 410), and 2025-2027 (+0.027525, 491). The 10-day ICIR falls below the daily admission threshold, so this is primarily a daily/short-horizon factor. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
